_doc: #870 THE REBUILD-ISOLATION RULE (owner): a change in a shared lib ships ONLY that lib's APK (apps bind lib APKs at runtime); an app ships only on changes under its own dir plus the explicit non-lib inputs below; a lib change never rebuilds another lib; a regenerated shared manifest never starts an app. Everything an app compiles but does not own is HASHED by the publish gate (so its next own-dir build carries it) and never WATCHED by GitHub. Held by cloud-android-rebuild-isolation-guard.py (every push) and rebuild-scenarios.json.
_doc_manifests: Shared generated/declared data. Hashed into an app that reads it, never watched, never a fleet-refresh reason (a baked-in copy goes stale until the app's next own-dir build; fresh data is a runtime fetch).
_doc_explicit_inputs: Non-lib inputs an app watches on purpose. ab_cloud-libs-shared/build.json carries firestack.artifact (the prebuilt netstack aar pin SuperApp links): advancing the pin IS a change to what ships and touches no app dir.
_doc_own_extra_globs: An app's fork/source engine script is the app's own code (single consumer), so it counts as owned.
